Dashboard.js links at lines 129 and 157 correctly include ?instance=${instanceId} parameter
Conversations.js properly displays conversation list with filters (All, Web, Discord, Approved)
Approve for Training toggle works correctly via PATCH /conversations/{session_id}/approve
